newsitem.title: UK: Meristem warns on first half profits.
newsitem.headline: Meristem warns on first half profits.

text.p: Meristem Plc said on Tuesday that profitability in the first half of 1997 is likely to be "substantially" less than in the first half of 1996.
However, the company told shareholders at its annual meeting it expected the major profit contribution to come in the second half.
"The continuing strength of sterling has had some adverse impact across the group," said the chemicals and minerals group.
It also noted that the group has suffered lower sales at its businesses Colin Stewart Minchem (CSM) and Solvitol, where it is incurring exceptional restructuring costs.

"During the second half of 1997, we expect to benefit from new product sales at CSM, our efforts to strengthen profitability at Solvitol and a continued robust performance from E Wood," said the firm.
